comment: Differences between the editor's CiA 306 check and the other checkers that the standard decides for the editor. See .github/scripts/canopen_dcf_crosscheck.py.

exceptions.reason: The file must be ASCII. Lely reads it as UTF-8 and stops; the editor reads the text as Windows-1252 and warns (not-ascii).
The formula is $NODEID+n; n+$NODEID is not the formula form. Lely refuses it, the editor reads it as the formula with a warning (nodeid-formula), which is the agreed choice.
A REAL value written as a decimal number is valid. Lely reads REAL values only as a hexadecimal bit pattern.
